title: What quitting exercise does
description:
Week by week: how your stamina, heart, muscles and blood pressure change when you stop working out.
#fitness #exercise #science #health
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

music.credit: Music: "Inspired" - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

lines.hook: What happens if you stop exercising?
lines.b1: After two weeks off, your stamina can already start to slip.
lines.b2: By week three, your heart beats faster for the same workout.
lines.b3: After a month, the muscle you built can start to shrink.
lines.b4: By two months, your blood pressure can creep back up.
lines.b5: Three months in, much of your hard-won fitness can be gone.
lines.end: So, when did you last break a sweat?
